沪市主板A与科创板 + 深市主板A与创业板A + 北交所股票；不含B股、基金、债: Shanghai main-board A-shares and STAR, Shenzhen main-board A-shares and ChiNext, plus Beijing stocks. Excludes B-shares, funds, bonds and repos. Summed only when all three exchanges report for the same date. Shenzhen A-share volume remains unverified, so total share volume is unavailable.
沪深交易所官方日度统计: Official Shanghai and Shenzhen daily statistics
沪市主板A与科创板 + 深市主板A与创业板A；不含北交所、B股、基金、债券和回购: Shanghai main-board A-shares and STAR, plus Shenzhen main-board A-shares and ChiNext. Excludes Beijing, B-shares, funds, bonds and repos. Summed only for matching dates.
主板A（01）与科创板（03）相加，排除B股、回购。成交额原单位亿元，成交量原单: Main-board A-shares (01) plus STAR (03), excluding B-shares and repos. Source units: CNY 100 million and 100 million shares, retaining the source’s two-decimal precision.
主板A股与创业板A股成交金额相加，排除主板B股、基金和债券。深市日度概况的合计成: Main-board A-share plus ChiNext turnover, excluding B-shares, funds and bonds. Total volume in Shenzhen’s daily overview includes B-shares and is not used as pure A-share volume.
北交所股票市场日报（xxzrlx=2），排除新三板。成交金额原单位元，成交数量原: BSE daily stock report (xxzrlx=2), excluding NEEQ. Original units: CNY and shares. Block trades in footnotes are not added again.
Yahoo Finance 加密货币美元参考报价；按 UTC 日期保存已结束日线: Yahoo Finance crypto reference prices in USD. Only completed UTC daily bars are stored. Changes are relative to the previous daily bar, not rolling 24 hours. Volume units are unverified and are not displayed.
Yahoo 近月期货日线，非现货或固定合约。滚动换月可能产生跳变，区间涨跌不等于: Yahoo front-month futures daily bars, not spot or a fixed contract. Contract rolls may cause jumps; period changes are not investable returns.
每1美元兑换的在岸人民币数量；数值上升表示美元升值。供应商日线参考报价，非中间价: Onshore CNY per USD; an increase indicates a stronger dollar. Provider daily reference quote, not the official fixing.
每1美元兑换的离岸人民币数量；供应商日线参考报价。: Offshore CNH per USD; provider daily reference quote.
固定期限国债收益率，非债券价格；官方日频数据有发布滞后。: Constant-maturity Treasury yield, not bond price. Official daily data may be published with a delay.
固定期限国债收益率，非债券价格；日变化以基点表示。: Constant-maturity Treasury yield, not bond price. Daily changes are expressed in basis points.
固定期限国债收益率；缺失日期不补零。: Constant-maturity Treasury yield. Missing dates are not filled with zero.
美国担保隔夜融资利率；按 effectiveDate 归档，次工作日发布。: US Secured Overnight Financing Rate, dated by effectiveDate and published the next business day.
实际有效利率 EFFR，非美联储政策目标区间。: Effective Federal Funds Rate (EFFR), not the Fed’s policy target range.
东方财富转引上海银行间同业拆放利率；按报告日期归档。: Shanghai Interbank Offered Rate via Eastmoney, dated by report date.
人民币1周期同业拆放利率，非贷款市场报价利率 LPR。: One-week RMB interbank offered rate, not the Loan Prime Rate (LPR).
指数日线收盘价与源成交量（手）；统计范围依指数，不代表全市场。每条历史记录保留实: Index daily close and source volume in lots. Coverage is index-specific, not whole-market. Each observation retains its actual source.
每1美元兑换的离岸人民币数量，东方财富日线参考报价；仅记录已结束的日期。: Offshore CNH per USD, from Eastmoney daily reference quotes. Only completed dates are stored.
恒生科技指数日线收盘价。该源成交字段口径未核实，暂不展示；逐条历史保留实际来源。: Hang Seng Tech daily close. Source volume methodology is unverified and is not displayed. Each observation retains its actual source.
